counter_contract.L2_accepted_sectors: GLOBAL_ACC_R HIT+HIT_RESERVED+MISS+SECTOR_MISS; excludes RESERVATION_FAIL retries and supplementary MSHR_HIT/WRITE_ALLOCATED buckets.
counter_contract.DRAM_read_atoms: Sum controller n_rd actual READ column commands; 32B configured atom, not unique address count.
counter_contract.avg_mrq_latency: Core-cycle interval dram_req_t construction at DRAM interface to bank assignment from FRFCFS scheduler; excludes earlier L2 FIFO and subsequent bank/DRAM service. Population is schedule assignments, not fixed application-request cohort. Printed integer mean.
counter_contract.gpu_stall_dramfull: Legacy print alias for gpu_stall_icnt2mem: per-subpartition/L2-clock-tick event when memory input full and ICNT has packet. Not L2->DRAM FIFO full, not unique GPU stall-cycle union.
counter_contract.cumulative_kernel_prints: Per-kernel cycles are increments; other counter populations audited as cumulative, so second-kernel population is final minus first. Do not sum cumulative terminal prints.
counter_contract.static_trace: B single shared producer only; full slow kernels SHA verified. Static line-reference interval is not stack reuse distance or actual cross-SM temporal locality.
counter_contract.mean_service: Post-all-ready load-service interval only; excludes pre-ready requests/metadata and cannot be compared directly with conventional20cycle latency.

hypotheses.claim: DH has fewer accepted L2 GLOBAL_ACC_R sectors but a larger accepted-miss fraction; its accepted read misses exactly match issued DRAM read atoms in each of these six closed original cells.
hypotheses.causal_limit: Arithmetic and counter-domain explanation; does not establish which schedule/cache policy caused the miss increase.

hypotheses.claim: Negative application differences originate in strided kernel: ATAX/MVT K1, BICG K2. The other, coalesced kernel is faster under DH.
hypotheses.causal_limit: Kernel-level localization only, not unique microarchitectural cause.

hypotheses.claim: Same input has matrix lane stride 16384 bytes, alternating 32-line and broadcast/1-line global load records, about 33 static 128B line references per unique line and only 16 CTAs on 64 SMs.
hypotheses.causal_limit: Trace body order is not simulated cross-SM time; static repetition is not a duplicate outstanding request. Low CTA is shared and cannot independently explain CH/DH difference.

hypotheses.claim: DH has greater L2 accepted-miss fraction, higher controller request imbalance, higher DRAM-scheduler pre-bank waiting and greater ICNT-to-L2 input backpressure while strided kernel slows.
hypotheses.causal_limit: Temporal locality/replacement/re-request timing is a candidate connecting path. No address-timestamp L2 replacement or DRAM overlap history is available.

hypotheses.claim: Tag invalidation while physical references remain live causes overlapping DRAM reads for the same line across distinct physical generations.
hypotheses.causal_limit: Deferred reclaims and static revisits exist; no request-ID/address/generation/timestamp join proves duplicate DRAM traffic. Could be sequential re-miss after reuse, altered scheduling, bank conflicts, or combinations.

hypotheses.claim: Independent OO physical-pool exhaustion or PIB saturation materially causes the remaining slowdown.
hypotheses.causal_limit: Source has real NO_FREE_LINE and PIB-full rejection paths, but corresponding OO terminal counters were not printed. Mean occupancy and final current occupancy cannot establish absence or saturation.

hypotheses.claim: Measured ready-to-complete post-ready service is only a few cycles and ready-but-writeback-blocked events are small, while lower-create queue-full and common lower-cap-full are measured zero.
hypotheses.causal_limit: Evidence reduces the plausibility of those measured points dominating; it does not exclude pre-ready metadata, bank/Tag, allocation-width, physical or PIB admission blocking.

hypotheses.claim: DRAM bandwidth or the L2-to-DRAM FIFO is the sole causal bottleneck.
hypotheses.causal_limit: avg_mrq_latency excludes prior L2 FIFO residence and later bank/DRAM service. E reports mixed PQ CH effects and PS changes both service and absolute DRAM timing plus traffic; all DH P0-to-PQ/PS sensitivity pairs and relative recovery factors remain pending in its fixed snapshot; the BICG PS CH/DH within-profile pair is already accepted.

hypotheses.claim: CH and DH have unequal L1/data/Tag geometry, per-address merge limits, PIB design and hit/complete timing.
hypotheses.causal_limit: Original four-config evidence compares complete modeled designs, not an isolated equal-area Tag/Data-decoupling effect.

minimal_discriminating_experiments.name: Bounded observation-only matched CH/DH request and blocking attribution
minimal_discriminating_experiments.scope: Three frozen full input digests; six matched CH/DH points on one explicitly registered Core/FW/binary. No replacement of original accepted cells. Prefer same scientific model as downstream18 for any future joins, after proving observation-only timing equivalence; never combine cross-source control values.
minimal_discriminating_experiments.change: Only bounded instrumentation and counters; no queues, capacities, service quotas, timing, Hash or scheduler changes. Counters per SM/kernel for PIB-full, NO_FREE_LINE, allocation-width, Tag grant rejects, lower-create/full, refill/notify/gather/retire blocking; record request lineage at lower creation, L2 accepted lookup, replacement/fill, DRAM ingress/bank assignment/column issue/return.
minimal_discriminating_experiments.distinguishes: Simultaneous same-line DRAM duplicate vs later sequential re-miss vs L2 replacement/locality and which blocking point actually delays progress. Same address alone insufficient; count accepted requests once by root+sector identity.
minimal_discriminating_experiments.resource_limit: One bounded in-memory ring <=64MiB per process; deterministic predeclared sample selection and <=128MiB compressed event output per point; full-population scalar counters retained, dropped-event counter mandatory; no posthoc claim of complete request population from sampled records. Finite point/runtime budget must be separately registered.
minimal_discriminating_experiments.validation: CPU synthetic-event tests; population/accepted conservation; event sequence lineage; existing non-scientific qualification paths only before launch. Verify cycle-equivalence on explicitly authorized reference execution before treating instrumented point as observational.

minimal_discriminating_experiments.name: One-factor L2 associativity/capacity sensitivity after request audit
minimal_discriminating_experiments.scope: Start with MVT CH/DH, the largest original relative regression; registered full digest unchanged. Two additional variant points against a matched same-build pair.
minimal_discriminating_experiments.change: Predeclare L2 ways16->32 with sets128, line128B, sector32B and partition mapping unchanged; fixed hit/port timing and all other parameters. Capacity rises10MiB->20MiB.
minimal_discriminating_experiments.distinguishes: Whether increased L2 residency reduces observed repeated accepted misses/DRAM atoms and recovers cycles. This diagnoses residency sensitivity but cannot alone separate conflict from capacity; request-event replay into a shadow fully-associative cache requires actual temporal sequence.
minimal_discriminating_experiments.caveat: Diagnostic constant-latency capacity change, not a physical area/timing-matched design or a paper baseline promotion.

minimal_discriminating_experiments.name: Only if blocking counters implicate physical or completion resource
minimal_discriminating_experiments.scope: One predeclared culprit input, one DH variant plus matching same-build DH baseline; separate single-factor contracts.
minimal_discriminating_experiments.change: Choose exactly one resource from evidence: physical lines640->768, OO PIB128->256, or matched pipelined completion service. Never enlarge all at once.
minimal_discriminating_experiments.distinguishes: Measure reduction of the named reject/blocked event and corresponding accepted miss/DRAM/cycle response. If counters do not implicate resource, do not run this variation.
minimal_discriminating_experiments.caveat: Budget/area differences explicit; Tag logical512 and Hash stay fixed for a physical-pool-only test. No execution authorized here.
